channels.label: ROC_LOC
channels.reason: Bipolar ROC-LOC derivation combines both eyes, so it maps to the generic EOG target.

channels.label: Fp2_F4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain Fp2-F4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: F4_C4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain F4-C4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_P4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain C4-P4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: P4_O2
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain P4-O2 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_A1
channels.reason: C4 referenced to contralateral mastoid A1 (M1) is the C4-M1 derivation, and the trace looks neural.

channels.label: EMG1_EMG2
channels.reason: Bipolar EMG1-EMG2 with a 10-100 Hz filter and EMG-like trace is the chin EMG.

channels.label: ECG1_ECG2
channels.reason: ECG1-ECG2 bipolar lead with an ECG-like trace.

channels.label: DX1_DX2
channels.reason: DX (Italian destra, right) EMG channel with an EMG trace is the right leg EMG.

channels.label: SX1_SX2
channels.reason: SX (Italian sinistra, left) EMG channel with an EMG trace is the left leg EMG.

channels.label: TORACE
channels.reason: TORACE (Italian for thorax) is the thoracic effort belt and shows a respiratory trace.

channels.label: ADDOME
channels.reason: ADDOME (Italian for abdomen) is the abdominal effort belt and shows a respiratory trace.

channels.label: Position
channels.reason: Body position channel with discrete values.

channels.label: SAO2
channels.reason: Oximeter SaO2 in % with an SpO2-like trace.

channels.label: MIC
channels.reason: Microphone sound channel filtered at 10-80 Hz is the snore sensor.

channels.label: PLETH
channels.reason: Oximeter pulse waveform with a pleth-like trace.

channels.label: STAT
channels.reason: Oximeter status channel with a flat trace and no canonical counterpart.
